question: By whom and concerning which class was the teaching told, as addressed to the beloved one?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-movers and good-eaters is in question.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: By an earth-mover, the teaching concerning the earth-movers and good-eaters was told, O beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved one, the teaching concerning the earth-movers and good-eaters was told by an earth-mover.
